Fairmont State's Frank LaFone Honored with Geospatial Lifetime Achievement Award

2026-09-08 News Release, My Buckhannon Frank LaFone, Fairmont State University, WVAGP, GIS, geospatial professionals, lifetime achievement award, West Virginia, VerySpatial podcast, GISP certification, GIS education, geospatial technology
Read the source article

Quick summary

Dr. Frank LaFone, geography faculty member at Fairmont State University, has received the West Virginia Association of Geospatial Professionals Lifetime Achievement Award for over two decades of contributions to GIS and geospatial technology across the state.

Key takeaways

  • Dr. Frank LaFone honored with the WVAGP Lifetime Achievement Award for career-long contributions to GIS in West Virginia
  • He was a founding member and key architect of the West Virginia Association of Geospatial Professionals (WVAGP)
  • LaFone earned his GISP certification early in the program's history and served multiple terms on the WVAGP Board, including as president and vice president
  • He co-founded VerySpatial, one of the longest-running geography and geospatial podcasts, contributing to professional education nationally and internationally
  • The award was presented at WV GEOCON, West Virginia's annual geospatial conference
  • As a faculty member at Fairmont State University, LaFone continues to connect students with geospatial technology opportunities to address community needs
